articles.title: AmericanFortress proposes quantum-safe crypto wallet protection without fund migration
articles.snippet: The proposed cryptographic scheme aims to protect existing Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana wallets from future quantum attacks without requiring users to move funds or change wallet addresses.
